reviews.author: J. Gay
reviews.text: Corríher Electric recently installed a new 200-amp electrical service in my building. They also installed new light fixtures and multiple outlets throughout the building. From start to finish, Randy was professional, knowledgeable, and dependable. He explained the work clearly, completed the project on schedule, and made sure everything was installed safely and up to code. The quality of the workmanship was outstanding, and the installation was clean and well organized. Randy paid attention to detail, kept me informed throughout the project, and left the work area spotless when they were finished. It's clear he takes pride in delivering high-quality work. I highly recommend Corríher Electric to anyone looking for a reliable and experienced electrical contractor. I will definitely use them again for future electrical projects

reviews.author: Jeannie Beaver
reviews.text: Just want to give a shout out to Mr Randy Corriher for the outstanding, professional work that he did at our home. I would highly recommend him for any electrical work. He's very reasonably priced. He very neat with his work and cleans up throughout the job. He replaced lighting, added a dedicated circuit, added outside outlets, changed 2-space interior outlets to 4-space and installed some ceiling fans. Will definitely keep him in my reservoir of house maintenance contacts.

reviews.author: Sara Compton
reviews.text: I had a great experience working with Randy to update the outlets and switches in my whole house. He was reliable, easy to communicate with, efficient, knowledgeable, and pleasant to chat with over the two and a half day project. He explained confusing electrical things in a way that made sense. His pricing was very reasonable. If you need electrical work done, I absolutely recommend Randy!
